comment.text: Label of a toggle switch on the Security > External sharing page of the portal settings, shown to administrators under the external sharing links options. Turns external links of private (end-to-end encrypted) rooms on or off for the whole portal. Noun phrase, no period; 'private rooms' is the name of the encrypted rooms section.

usage.context:
<ToggleButton
 className={styles.privateRoomLinksToggle}
 isChecked={privateRoomLinks}
 isDisabled={isSaving}
 onChange={onChange}
 label={t("Settings:PrivateRoomLinks")}
 dataTestId="private_room_links_toggle"
 />
